title: fix(app-shell): hand the record page the row the viewer may read, so page:header's H1 stops printing denied fields (objectui#10499)
body:
Fixes #10499
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`page:header` builds the record page H1 from `RecordContext.data`, and `@object-ui/components` has no permission source. The host now hands that context the row the viewer may read, so the header needs no permission read of its own and no new copy of the field-read rule exists.

- `RecordDetailView` computes `readablePageRecord`: the loaded record passed through the module-private `withoutDeniedFields` it already had (objectui#10434), the objectui#10411 rule `!perms.isLoaded || perms.checkField(object, f, 'read')`, `id` and `_id` kept. That is the row ObjectStack's `FieldMasker` already serves.
- `RecordContextProvider` gets `data={readablePageRecord}`, and the record-title effect (breadcrumb, favourite, "Recently Accessed") reads the same value instead of calling the helper itself.
- `readableRow` caches the gated copy in a module `WeakMap` keyed on the served row object and its kept keys. It is not a `useMemo` identity (AGENTS.md #10), so a re-render never republishes an equal row to every block as a new object.
- `containers.tsx` is untouched. No export, schema, `RecordContext` member or accept set changes, which is why `Clause-②: no`.

## Route measured (PM hypothesis 1 held)

The three routes the triage named:

1. **Gate the row at the host.** Chosen. It stays inside the existing hand-off, reuses the in-file helper and adds no export.
2. **A read policy injected through context.** This needs a new `RecordContextValue` member in `@object-ui/react` plus a gate inside `@object-ui/components`. That gate would be another copy of the rule, or a new shared export while objectui#10501 may decide one. Not taken.
3. **A new dependency, components on `@object-ui/permissions`.** The same second-copy problem applies, and `permissions` exports no row gate today. Not taken.

## Blast radius (measured, not assumed)

The row feeds every block of the record page, not only the header. Every consumer of `RecordContext.data` now reads a denied field as absent: `page:header` (title, `title` / `subtitle` interpolation, action predicates), `record:details`, `record:highlights`, `record:path`, `record:alert`, `record:quick_actions`, `LineItemsPanel`, and `SchemaRenderer`'s `record.*` binding for node predicates.

This only moves anything when all three hold: a policy has loaded, it denies a field, and the backend served that field anyway. On a stripping backend, the row is the same object.

Measured on the real page, as `document.body.textContent` on a non-stripping backend with `email` denied and `titleFormat: '{email}'`:

- **Before:** `ada@example.com` appeared twice, in the H1 and in the default `record:highlights` strip. That strip gates by field only with `enforceFieldSecurity: true`. `Ada Lovelace` appeared **0** times.
- **After:** `ada@example.com` appears 0 times. `Ada Lovelace` appears once, as the H1.

The ActionProvider record, `InlineEditSaveBar`, `RelatedRecordActionsBridge` and the header Edit/Delete predicates still read the served `pageRecord`. They are not part of the page hand-off and are unchanged.

## Pins

New file: `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.pageHeaderTitleFls-10499.test.tsx`. It renders the real `RecordDetailView` (default composition, `page:header` over `record:details`) with a real `PermissionProvider` denying `email`, on a non-stripping `findOne`.

- `titleFormat: '{email}'`: the H1 reads `Ada Lovelace`, and the email is nowhere on the page.
- `nameField: 'email'`: the H1 reads `Ada Lovelace`. The resolver walks past the withheld pointer to its derivation, which is the stripping-backend answer.
- `titleFormat: '{name} - {email}'`: the H1 reads `Ada Lovelace`, and the email is nowhere on the page.
- The interim cost from triage note 3: `Ada Lovelace` appears exactly once, in the H1. ⚠️ The triage predicted "the `name` row returns under `record:details`". Measured, it does not return. The dedupe keeps hiding `name` because the H1 now **is** the name, which is the stripping-backend state. The readable name, which was on screen nowhere before, is on screen once.
- Blast radius: with no title reading `email`, the default highlight strip no longer prints it.
- CONTROL: a loaded policy denying `phone` leaves the H1 as `ada@example.com`.
- CONTROL: with no provider (`isLoaded` false), the H1 is `ada@example.com`.

## Reverse-verify

Run at head `b0dbc2af7`. The fix was committed first. Then `data={readablePageRecord}` was reverted to `data={pageRecord}`, with the on-disk counts checked (readable 1 to 0, raw 1 to 2), and the pin file re-run: **5 failed / 2 passed**. The five pins went red and both controls stayed green. The file was restored with `git checkout HEAD --` under a trap, `git diff HEAD` was 0 bytes, and the disk hash equalled the HEAD blob `bff7a81c`. One earlier ablation invocation was refused by `vitest-invocation-guard` (a directory filter was appended by mistake), so it never ran. That run counts as NOT MEASURED and is not a result.

## Gates (at head `b0dbc2af7`, after merging `origin/main`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run` on the new pin file and `RecordDetailView.titleFls-10434.test.tsx`: 11/11 passed.
- The 60 app-shell test files that reference `RecordDetailView`, run in two batches: 30 files / 307 tests and 30 files / 229 tests, all passed, at `f8324d4a7`. The merge from `origin/main` brought no change to app-shell, plugin-detail, permissions or the components layout renderers.
- **NOT MEASURED: the full app-shell package run.** Reason: `timeout 570` expired under the container's 10-minute foreground cap (exit 124). This is a declared narrowing; CI's four test shards run the whole package.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (both `tsc` passes): exit 0. The new test is in the `tsconfig.test.json` file list (`--listFiles`, 1 hit). It ran after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'` (28/28).
- `eslint` on the two touched source files: 0 errors. `RecordDetailView.tsx` has 111 warnings, equal to `origin/main`'s 111. The test file has 4 `no-explicit-any` warnings, the same shape as the objectui#10434 test. The workflow sets no `--max-warnings`.
- `check-changeset-presence` 0 · `check-changeset-no-major` 0 · `check:changeset-claims` 0 (report-only) · `check:pending-changeset-literals` 0 · `check:new-line-citations` 0 (0 new) · `check:control-bytes` 0 · `check:test-path-roots` 0 · `check:vi-mock-specifiers` / `-inherit` / `-override-shape` 0 · `check:unreferenced-sources` 0.

## Acceptance notes

- The pending `.changeset/10434-record-title-fls.md` still says a `page:header` "still builds its heading from the record as served". On the `RecordDetailView` host, this change makes that sentence false. The file is outside this card's surface, so it is not edited here; the seat may want to reword it before release.
- The `record-details.tsx` comment above `withoutDeniedFields(ctx.data …)` says the same thing ("`page:header` still builds its H1 from the row as served"). It stays true for any other host that hands a raw row. On this host it is now stale.
- `page:header` itself still has no read gate. Any other host that mounts `RecordContextProvider` with a raw row and a denying policy would print a denied title. Which other hosts, if any, do that was not surveyed here. This is an observation, not a filed finding.
- The identity guarantee of `readableRow` (the same gated object for the same served row) is argued in its docstring and is **not pinned by a test**.
